name: Ocal Browser v9.1.05 (Stable)
body:
## 🌌 Ocal Browser v9.1.05 (Stable) — Release Notes

### 🧩 Google Chrome Extensions Engine
* **Universal Runtime Polyfills**: Complete compatibility shims for `chrome.windows`, `chrome.storage.sync`/`session`, `chrome.action`, `chrome.tabs`, `chrome.runtime`, `chrome.scripting`, and `chrome.contextMenus`.
* **Web Store Support**: Run extensions like AHA Music, Grammarly, Return YouTube Dislike, and Dark Reader natively.
* **1-Click Web Store Injector**: Injected smart install buttons and floating installation banners directly into `chromewebstore.google.com` with real-time progress, theme mode, and accent color synchronization.
* **Dynamic Popup Auto-Sizing Engine**: Sizing engine measures declared CSS rules and DOM bounds in real time, eliminating horizontal gaps and vertical clipping.
* **Resolved ID Aliasing**: Perfect matching for extensions using Google Web Store ID aliases like uBlock Origin.

### 🎨 Modern 2D Branding & Refined UI
* **Refined Weather & System Status**: Atmospheric icon styling and emerald shields with live status indicators.
* **Seamless AI Pill Interactions**: Fixed hover animations so icons remain crisp and visible across light and dark modes.
* **New 2D Squircle Branding**: Clean, professional 2D squircle app icon matching modern desktop design standards.
* **Emerald PDF Viewer Icon**: Dedicated 2D emerald branding icon for built-in PDF document handling.

### 🏪 Microsoft Store & Win32 Installer Reliability
* **Surface Laptop & ARM64/x64 Emulation Support**: Fully validated for Windows 11 on ARM64 Surface Laptops and x64 architectures.
* **Dual-Mode Silent Ingestion**: Standard user installation without UAC prompts (`PrivilegesRequired=lowest`), fully compatible with Microsoft Partner Center automated ingestion tests.
* **Add or Remove Programs Registry Fixes**: Clean `HKA` registration under `Ocal Browser` by `Gaming Network Studio Media Group`.
* **Detailed Component Catalog**: Inno Setup installer with selectable types (`full`, `compact`, `custom`) and component isolation (`core`, `pdfviewer`).
